Implemented the fix in `tsdb/head_append.go`:

- Initialize `lastHistogramValue` / `lastFloatHistogramValue` inside series creation before the series becomes visible, preventing races with concurrent `Commit`.
- Guard `AppendHistogramCTZeroSample` initialization with the series lock and avoid overwriting an already-committed value.

Validation: `go test -race -run TestHeadAppendHistogramAndCommitConcurrency ./tsdb` passes. Related histogram/CT tests also pass. The full `tsdb` suite only hit unrelated timing-sensitive failures (`TestDelayedCompaction`, `TestTombstoneCleanRetentionLimitsRace`).
